name: smwmusic-rolling-thunder
title: Rolling Thunder 2 (Genesis) - View of Dynamism
description:
This is View of Dynamism, the Stage 5 theme from Rolling Thunder 2. The original Arcade release of the soundtrack was done by Ayako Saso, but for this one I based it on the Genesis/Mega Drive version, which was arranged by Hiromi Shibano, while adding a few small flourishes of my own.

Anyway, I think that this would be best used either in desert/pyramid type levels or be used for stealth type of levels in general. I don't have many other ideas tho sadly.
